clinician.trajectory_summary: A 37-year-old Hispanic man presented in 2007 with hemodynamic cardiac compromise due to a large cardiac mass, which was diagnosed as DLBCL. He was treated with R-CHOP chemotherapy and radiotherapy, followed by a bone marrow transplant, achieving remission for 4 years. In 2012, he developed neurological symptoms, and brain imaging revealed a mass in the third ventricle. A brain biopsy confirmed recurrent DLBCL, with an immunophenotype (CD10, CD19, CD20, kappa light chain restriction) that the final diagnosis states is similar to the initial cardiac tumor, confirming cerebral relapse.
